texts.facts: Petitioner seeks an order of police protection for his proprietary concern, which is shown to be functioning with due licences. A crime has already been registered against the private respondents for an incident which allegedly happened on 16.10.2016 for throwing stones causing damage to the petitioner's vehicles. Petitioner's unit was apparently attempted to be attacked under the premise that it causes pollution. With the available materials and certificates, the petitioner is entitled to carry out the WP(C)37368/16 activities. He has the requisite licence from the Grama Panchayat, integrated consent to operate issued by the Kerala State Pollution Control Board, licence from the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India and licence under the Factories and Boilers Act.
